name: repobridge
description: Expose your VS Code workspace as a remote MCP server via ngrok

repobridge.autoStart.description: Automatically start RepoBridge when a workspace folder is opened.

repobridge.mcp.port.description: Local MCP HTTP port (0 = pick a free port).

repobridge.ngrok.enabled.description: Try to expose MCP via ngrok when an authtoken is available. If ngrok fails or no token is set, RepoBridge still starts on localhost.

repobridge.ngrok.authtoken.description: ngrok authtoken. Also reads NGROK_AUTHTOKEN or .vscode/.env in the extension install folder (see README for F5).

repobridge.ngrok.domain.description: Optional reserved ngrok domain (static URL), e.g. my-app.ngrok-free.app. Also reads NGROK_DOMAIN from .vscode/.env. Falls back to a random ngrok URL if unavailable.

scripts.test: tsx --test src/workspace/security.test.ts src/workspace/filesystem.test.ts src/workspace/search.test.ts src/workspace/directories.test.ts src/ngrok/config.test.ts src/mcp/clientLabel.test.ts
